entry: bin/pi-tidy-bots.mjs -> cli.main -> startFleet -> daemon local HTTP builder and event reducer
normalization: Only clock/random identities are relational; order, full text, public statuses, canonical IDs and native correlation are asserted.
unsafeLegacyGaps: A 202 unknown response has no durable operation receipt or inspection route; do not replay it automatically.
clientMessageId duplicate rejection is process-local, not restart-safe idempotency.
Question responses have no durable decision receipt; accepted records a local write, not a proven native effect.
HTTP 200 for compaction can mean compacted=false; acceptance is not completion.
Pending JSONL persistence is best-effort; successful queue tracing is not a crash-durability certification.
At baseline foreground SIGTERM exited before handle.stop and left a fresh lock; the real-bin regression now requires cleanup before exit.
Legacy --port 0 passes port 0 to native reverse calls; this baseline handoff uses an OS-selected explicit spare port.
